Subject: Discovery recap & PoC onboarding plan - FastRetail

Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery to make sure we're aligned and to lay out the PoC/onboarding plan.

Pain points & goals:
- Latency spikes on peak traffic (checkout flow) leading to cart abandonment (~3-4% uplift in abandonments).
- Need consistent, low-latency recommendations and customer messaging generation.
- Goal: reduce API latency 50% p95 and improve throughput to serve ~200 requests/sec during peak.

Current stack:
- Frontend: Next.js (Node 18)
- Backend: Express/Node + Python microservices
- DB: Postgres (RDS)
- Hosting: AWS (us-east-1)

Success criteria for PoC (agreed):
- Achieve p95 latency < 200ms for 128-token completions under simulated peak.
- Integration using existing Node backend with minimal code changes.
- Clear cost estimate for production at 200 req/sec.

Integration & onboarding plan (proposed):
1) Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + access exchange (HubSpot/POC workspace).
2) Week 1: API integration using Redwood Node SDK (we'll provide code samples) + sample traffic replay.
3) Week 2: Load testing and performance tuning (batching/quantization suggestions).
4) Week 3: Finalize metrics against success criteria and handoff plan.

Owners:
- FastRetail: Sam (product lead), Priya (engineering)
- Redwood: Ben Carter (sales/technical lead), Marissa Cole (solutions/CS), Jordan Blake (platform/tech)

Requested next steps:
- Sam/Priya: Confirm access (API endpoint + test dataset) and whether SSO/SOC2 requirements apply.
- Redwood: Share mutual action plan + PoC timeline and Node SDK sample by EOD.

I've attached a short mutual action plan and PoC timeline. Proposed next meeting: Apr 22, 2026 10:00 AM EDT to kick off (invite pending). Let me know if that works.

Best,

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — this is great and captures the discussion. A few notes from our side:

1) Security & compliance: we are SOC 2 conscious and will need a copy of Redwood's SOC 2 report and an explanation of how logs/audit trails are handled during the PoC. We run Okta for SSO; can you support SAML/SCIM or provide API tokens scoped to the PoC?
2) Data residency: primary users are US-based, but we will need confirmation that test data will remain in us-east-1 for the PoC.
3) Access & dataset: Priya will share a small test dataset and a sample traffic replay by EOD tomorrow.
4) Kickoff: Apr 22 10:00 AM EDT works for our team. Priya, Sam and I will be on the call.

Action: We'll send firewall allowlist info and a contact for our security engineer (cc'd on later threads). Please send the mutual action plan and Node SDK examples.

Thanks — Sam

Hi Sam / Priya — quick technical confirmation ahead of kickoff: 

- SDKs: We will provide official Node and Python SDK examples for the PoC (Node sample delivered before the call).
- API compatibility: Redwood exposes a REST JSON endpoint; we also support gRPC for higher-throughput routes if you'd like to evaluate.
- Auth: We can support Okta via SAML for long-term, and provide short-lived API keys for PoC access.
- Data residency: PoC environment will be provisioned in us-east-1 and logs will be retained per agreed settings (will share retention policy doc).

Looking forward to the kickoff. I'll post the sample repo link and Node snippets to the HubSpot thread and Drive before the call.
